proposed_canonical_survivor_rule.timestamps: retain API start and end exactly
proposed_canonical_survivor_rule.primary_source_identity: retain UkraineAlarm API identity; keep region_id, api_region_name, alert_type, and bridge source_url semantics
proposed_canonical_survivor_rule.manual_source_identity: do not overwrite or replace the API row's primary source identity with manual recovery source fields

proposed_provenance_retention_rule.location: nested on the canonical UkraineAlarm API survivor
proposed_provenance_retention_rule.semantics: Preserve the manual recovery as factual provenance only; do not use it as the canonical timing or primary API source identity.

persisted_event_exact_key_seed.defect: Persisted events are keyed only by exact (city_key, start, end), so tolerance-equivalent rows with sub-second timestamp differences remain distinct.

api_exact_key_upsert.defect: Fresh UkraineAlarm rows are inserted by the same exact tuple key; a manual recovery row whose timestamps differ within MATCH_TOLERANCE_SECONDS is not reconciled.

serialization.effect: Both exact-key entries are serialized back to the persisted bridge.

proposed_minimal_repair_algorithm: Introduce one tolerance-aware completed-AIR equivalence check using the existing MATCH_TOLERANCE_SECONDS: same city_key and absolute start/end deltas each <= 15 seconds. Do not use generic interval overlap.
Run the same reconciliation against persisted store events before serialization so the already-persisted 52 manual/API pairs collapse even when no new API fetch introduces them.

For exactly one tolerance-equivalent pair consisting of one manual Alerts.in.ua recovery row and one UkraineAlarm API row, keep the API row and its timestamps and attach/merge the manual row under recovery_provenance.
Use the same tolerance-aware upsert when adding each fresh UkraineAlarm history event instead of assigning only by the exact (city_key, start, end) tuple.
Make provenance merge idempotent: rerunning must not duplicate the same recovery_provenance payload.

If a tolerance group contains multiple candidate API rows, multiple manual rows, an unexpected source structure, or any non-AIR/incomplete case, do not guess; flag/block that group for forensic review.
After reconciliation, sort exactly as today and recompute event_count. For this verified bridge state the deterministic reduction is 1540 -> 1488 events.
